answer_1.quote: Constrained commonsense generation. ... the task is to generate a coherent sentence ... Counterfactual explanation generation. ... the task is to generate reasons ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated coherent sentences for commonsense scenarios and generated explanations for counterfactual statements.

answer_2.quote: The task is evaluated by SPICE , BLEU-4 , ROUGE-L , CIDEr

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 50 generated outputs from the CommonGen dev set ... and 50 generated outputs from the ComVE test set. All evaluations were conducted on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT), and each evaluation form was answered by three AMT workers.
answer_4.guideline: The generated outputs are evaluated by fluency and accuracy. Fluency is assessed on the grammatical correctness and readability of the generated outputs disregarding the input text. Accuracy evaluates whether the output generated is correct and reasonable given the input text of each task.
